name: Certified n=68 refinement: s ≤ 8.798795237218283903
body:
This release gives a tighter **exact rational certificate** for packing 68 nonoverlapping unit squares in a square of side

**8.798795237218283902576680967021394083521019030227879263240370**

Equivalently, the shorter upward-rounded bound is **s(68) ≤ 8.798795237218283903**. The improvement over [v1.0.0](https://github.com/lollipoll/certified-square-packing-68/releases/tag/v1.0.0), whose exact side is 8.798795237221, is approximately **2.716097423319033 × 10⁻¹²**.

The refinement and certification were prepared by **Seth Rehwaldt with assistance from OpenAI Codex**. The work builds on the existing n=68 packing family and the contributions listed in the [Kingbird table](https://kingbird.myphotos.cc/packing/squares_in_squares.html), including Jake Loyd. The tighter contact branch is present in **Francisco Couzo's earlier public coordinates** ([franciscouzo](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/blob/3bfc47e4f53ab474cd7702cb81f831faf2f5846a/n68.txt)); that contribution retains its attribution. Discovery priority for a new arrangement is not claimed.

## Verification

Three separately written geometry implementations passed all 68 unit squares, containment, and **2,278 unordered pairs**, using exact rational arithmetic and **zero acceptance tolerance**. An additional review replayed the exact analytic checks and all seven supplied verifier tests.

To reproduce the checks using normal Python 3.9 or newer:

```bash
git clone --branch v1.1.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/lollipoll/certified-square-packing-68.git
cd certified-square-packing-68/refinement-v1.1.0
python3 check_hashes.py
python3 -B verify.py n68.json --n 68 --reference-side 8.798795237221
python3 -B independent_support_check.py n68.json --n 68
python3 -B verify_analytic.py
```

No third-party Python packages or optimizer are needed. Do not use Python's `-O` or `-OO` options. The attached `n68-refinement-v1.1.0.zip` provides the same self-contained verification folder.

SHA-256 of the authoritative `n68.json` certificate:

```text
6d4f72debae83b5825e91f7b090e0cee08851ad7b85400343c0dee52f468dff9
```

## Analytic results and scope

The bundle includes a rigorous enclosure of the selected algebraic contact-system root and exact bounds for two explicitly restricted families. The rational certificate is approximately **4.58039 × 10⁻⁶¹** above the enclosed contact-system side.

These results establish a feasible upper bound and restricted lower bounds. **Unrestricted local and global optimality remain unproved.** The contact root itself is not presented as a certified all-pairs packing; the rational certificate supplies the packing bound. Recognition in the table and priority relative to other submissions remain pending review.

## Assets

- `n68-refinement-v1.1.0.zip`: certificate, exact checkers, analytic witnesses, review evidence, documentation, and diagrams. Self-contained for the exact checks.
- `n68.json`: the standalone authoritative certificate, identical to the copy in the ZIP.
- `n68-refinement-campaign-20261007.tar.gz`: the unchanged original full optimization campaign, including checkpoints, source comparisons, and the analytic derivation.

The diagrams are approximate renderings; the rational coordinates define the construction.
